blockers.description: Release artifact bytes, signatures, notices, and imported-module identities are external.
Installation, import, dependencies, platform behavior, and numerical execution are not validated.
PyPI metadata cannot establish Basic/Pro desktop edition or entitlement.

ovito-pypi-release-metadata-inventory.title: OVITO 3.15.5 exact PyPI release metadata inventory

limitations: Exact PyPI metadata and wheel digests do not establish artifact bytes, signatures, imported module identity, Basic/Pro desktop identity, entitlement, runtime behavior, modifier validity, or scientific acceptance.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

distribution-artifacts-not-retained.description: Wheel files, installers, component notices, signatures, SBOMs, and imported module bytes are not downloaded or stored.

edition-boundary-not-proven-by-pypi.description: PyPI package metadata does not establish Basic desktop or Pro desktop entitlement, activation, or feature availability.

metadata-is-not-native-validation.description: Release metadata and artifact hashes do not establish installation, import, runtime dependencies, platform compatibility, API behavior, or numerical correctness.

raw-pypi-json-not-retained.description: The exact JSON response hash and derived release fields are retained, but the raw PyPI JSON body is not.
